name: Kinetica Pulse Active Trainer
description: A low-profile athletic trainer with a slightly chunky midsole housing the active cushioning system — visible as a faint hexagonal lattice through the translucent sidewall. The sole responds to impact force in real time, stiffening under heavy landings and softening for sustained running. Comes in white/grey, black/orange, and teal/white colorways.
functionality: Active cushioning lattice adjusts firmness in response to measured impact force, reducing joint stress by an estimated 30% over passive foam.
what_it_says: You take your health seriously without going full performance-athlete. These are shoes for someone who runs to work and means it.
story_hooks: The impact-response data logged by the trainer captured the exact force profile of a fall — or a fight.
A courier wearing these has been making deliveries that don't appear on any manifest, the shoes' GPS quietly confirming every stop.
